fusions.name: Host to Host
fusions.desc: Flicks a sting that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then jumps to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Pounce and Pierce
fusions.desc: You leap up to 7 tiles onto the target and sting it, dealing 14 damage and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Out From Under
fusions.desc: You hop 2 tiles and gain +20% dodge chance for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Springing Ambush
fusions.desc: Each time you cover enough ground, a sting leaps to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
